headline: Transfer rumors, news: Barcelona, Bayern eye Aston Villa's Manzambi
description: Both Barcelona and Bayern Munich are competing to sign Aston Villa's Johan Manzambi. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Carrick says he feels backed by Man United's board
description: Carrick says he feels backed by Man United's board

headline: Michael Carrick: I feel backing of Man United board but need to win games
description: Michael Carrick has said he feels the backing of the Manchester United board -- but admits it will only continue if he starts winning games.

headline: Referees' boss Webb backs VAR over Newcastle's Botman challenge on Villa's Jackson
description: Referees boss Howard Webb believes the video assistant referee was right not to intervene after Newcastle's Sven Botman was shown a yellow card for his tackle on Aston Villa's Nicolas Jackson at the weekend.

headline: Animal rights group PETA call for Crystal Palace to retire bald eagle mascot
description: Animal rights group PETA has urged Crystal Palace to retire the club's bald eagle mascot, Phoenix, with immediate effect.

headline: Cesc Fàbregas calls suggestions he could replace Michael Carrick at Man United disrespectful
description: Cesc Fabregas has dismissed suggestions he could be in line to replace Michael Carrick as disrespectful.
